with vw_send_dt as
(
	select distinct send_dt from cd_ods.tb_sf_fnb_ext_send_dalpha where send_dt >= '20260601'
),
dataset2 as 
(
	select distinct send_dt from cd_ods.tb_sf_standard_dataset2
)
select a.send_dt as send_dt from vw_send_dt a
left join dataset2 b
on a.send_dt = b.send_dt
where coalesce (b.send_dt,'') = ''

      ,a.ordergoodsno
      ,a.regdt
      ,a.moddt

    ,cd_beston.es_goods b
